basics.name: Kishore Prakash
basics.title: Mobile Engineering Lead
basics.headline: iOS & Cross-Platform Mobile Lead
basics.tagline: 11+ years building and leading iOS, Kotlin Multiplatform and NFC/BLE work — from enterprise facilities platforms to shipped SDKs and my own App Store products.
basics.summary: Mobile engineering lead with 11+ years designing, building and shipping iOS applications and SDKs across enterprise, telecom and semiconductor products. Currently at JLL on the Corrigo facilities-management suite, working across a 15-person mobile team. Owns mobile architecture end to end — app and SDK design through CI/CD, release and App Store delivery — with published SDKs used by NXP and Jabra partner teams and three App Store products of my own.
basics.summaryShort: Mobile engineering lead with 11+ years shipping iOS apps and SDKs across enterprise, telecom and semiconductor products. Owns architecture, CI/CD and App Store delivery end to end; specialises in Apple platforms, NFC and Bluetooth Low Energy.

experience.context: Global commercial real-estate services firm. Corrigo is JLL's facilities-management and CMMS product suite.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Build and ship iOS apps across JLL's Corrigo facilities suite — Corrigo, Corrigo Enterprise and CorrigoPro — in 19 languages, including QR- and NFC-driven service requests.
Own mobile architecture decisions for a 15-engineer team working across Swift, Objective-C and Kotlin.
Led the CocoaPods to Swift Package Manager migration, delivered ahead of schedule, and wrote the migration guide other teams adopted.
Led the Datadog integration on iOS, improving observability and diagnostics across the mobile estate.
Cut login time by roughly 50% and screen load times by up to 80% across the Corrigo apps.
Cut CI/CD build and release time by 30% on GitHub Actions, and grew XCTest coverage each release.
Standardised localisation and font accessibility across the suite.

experience.context: Reliance Jio's digital-platforms arm; consumer apps at national scale.

roles.title: Lead iOS Engineer
bullets: Led iOS for JioAICloud (Storage & Photos) from v58.0.0 with a team of 6.
Architected and shipped Platfom, a short-video product, from scratch — owned architecture and the feature roadmap.
Drove an app-size reduction programme on JioAICloud, cutting the binary by 25% to improve install conversion on low-bandwidth connections.
Designed scalable architecture for high-traffic products and mentored engineers on modularity and testing.
Maintained Jenkins CI/CD and XCTest suites, and represented iOS in cross-functional planning.

experience.context: Global IT services firm; engagement delivered NFC and secure-element products for NXP Semiconductors.

roles.title: Lead Analyst
bullets: Led iOS SDK engineering for NXP's MIFARE 2GO, turning a phone into a contactless transit ticket via a certified secure element.
Owned the SDK lifecycle: public API design, provisioning and payment flows, XCTest, a reference demo app and AsciiDoc/DocC docs.
Ran Jenkins CI/CD for multi-platform library builds and worked with NXP's core team on card structures.
Integrated REST backends behind enterprise mobile workflows and improved stability release over release.

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built mWallet2GO, an iOS SDK for contactless Mastercard and VISA payments via the secure element in phones and wearables.
Developed TapLinx, a Swift/Objective-C/C++ library for reading and writing NFC Forum tag types, used by NXP's own apps.
Shipped and maintained NXP's public NFC apps — TagInfo, TagWriter and AppXplorer.
Wrote the developer-facing SDK documentation and release notes partner integrators worked from.

experience.context: IT services firm; engagement delivered macOS and iOS SDKs and plugins for Jabra (GN Audio).

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Built the Jabra Universal SDK for macOS and iOS — device settings, call control and firmware update across the headset range.
Implemented BLE communication for pairing, firmware interaction and live headset status; improved connection stability across devices.
Developed macOS Jabra Softphone plugins bridging Skype, Bria and Avaya to Jabra hardware for remote call control.
Worked with hardware and firmware teams on reliable device communication, and wrote the manuals shipped to integrators.
Delivered an enterprise iOS app for American Red Cross employees behind Microsoft Enterprise SSO.

experience.company: IDS NEXT Business Solutions Pvt Ltd

roles.title: iOS Developer
bullets: Built Stay Ahead, letting guests of IDS-network hotels hold rooms, order room service and watch the folio bill live.
Developed Pulze247, giving hotel owners real-time property statistics and business-critical KPIs as graphs.
Defined app flow and UI with the design team and coordinated delivery with backend.

experience.context: Product engineering studio serving APAC clients.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Built Spizza for a Singapore pizza chain — menu and combo ordering, payment gateway, reservations and outlet maps.
Developed Personal Carpool, letting drivers and riders publish, match and manage rides.
Owned app flow and task assignment for a two-engineer team, interfacing with backend and UI/UX.

projects.name: Corrigo
projects.blurb: Occupant-facing facilities app. Raise a maintenance request by scanning a QR code or tapping an NFC tag on the equipment itself, then track status, review proposals and verify completed work.
highlights: Work-order status tracking and proposal review

projects.name: Corrigo Enterprise
projects.blurb: CMMS for facilities teams — work-order automation, asset tracking and preventative-maintenance scheduling, kept in sync with the desktop platform. Ships on iPhone, iPad and visionOS in 19 languages.
highlights: NFC and QR scanning from asset and work-order screens

projects.name: CorrigoPro
projects.blurb: The service-provider side of Corrigo. Technicians receive requests, post real-time updates and document work with photos — with geofencing that checks them in and out automatically as they arrive at and leave a site.

projects.name: JioAICloud — Storage & Photos
projects.blurb: Consumer cloud storage for photos, video, documents, music and contacts — automatic backup, cross-device access and shared collaboration on trips, events and projects.
highlights: Automatic and manual backup to JioCloud
Access from any phone or PC

projects.name: Platfom — Short Video App
projects.blurb: Short-video product built from scratch — create and publish short videos as stories. I owned the architecture and led the team through delivery.
highlights: Built from zero to App Store

projects.name: MIFARE 2GO
projects.blurb: iOS SDK for NXP's cloud service that turns a phone into a contactless transit ticket. Digital credentials live in an EAL 5+ certified secure element and extend beyond transit into access control and loyalty.
highlights: Card provisioning and contactless payment APIs

projects.name: mWallet2GO
projects.blurb: iOS SDK for contactless Mastercard and VISA payments through the secure-element chip inside a phone or wearable.

projects.name: TapLinx
projects.blurb: iOS library for reading and writing NFC data across NFC Forum tag types. Consumed internally by TagInfo, TagWriter and AppXplorer.

projects.name: NFC TagInfo by NXP
projects.blurb: Reads NFC Forum Type 2, Type 4 and Type 5 tags — including NXP's NTAG, ICODE and MIFARE platforms — and auto-executes the NDEF payload: open a URL, join Wi-Fi, import a vCard, drop a map pin, place a call.

projects.name: NFC TagWriter by NXP
projects.blurb: Writes contacts, bookmarks, geo locations, Bluetooth handover, SMS and mail records to NFC tags — posters, business cards, anything with an NFC inlay — then reads back and launches apps from what it finds.

projects.name: AppXplorer
projects.blurb: Discover smart-city services around you, then load and manage credentials over the air on an NFC device — event and hotel-room access, transport and bike rental.

projects.name: Jabra Universal macOS & iOS SDK
projects.blurb: One SDK across macOS and iOS for talking to Jabra headsets — device settings, call control and firmware update — shipped with a demo app showing integrators how to use it.

projects.name: Jabra iOS SDK
projects.blurb: iOS framework for communicating with Jabra Bluetooth devices — settings and firmware update — plus the reference demo app.

projects.name: Jabra Softphone Plugins for macOS
projects.blurb: macOS background service bridging softphones — Skype, Bria, Avaya — to Jabra hardware for remote call control.

projects.name: American Red Cross Employee App
projects.blurb: Enterprise iOS app giving American Red Cross employees a single entry point to their internal applications, behind Microsoft Enterprise SSO.

projects.name: Stotramala (Multilingual)
projects.blurb: My own App Store product: a multilingual reference library of over 7,000 Hindu stotras, ashtottaras and vedamantras. I run the whole thing — development, content pipeline, releases, ads and support.
highlights: YouTube integration and Google Ads monetisation

projects.name: ThoughtCast
projects.blurb: A performance tool for mentalists: the performer sees what a spectator is writing or drawing, live, as it happens. Bluetooth pen link plus on-device handwriting recognition.

projects.name: OmniSense — Magic & Mindreading
projects.blurb: Reveals which card, coin or object a spectator picked, using NFC tags read by the iPhone — with a companion Apple Watch app so the performer never touches their phone.

projects.name: Stay Ahead
projects.blurb: Universal iPhone/iPad app for guests of IDS-network hotels — hold rooms, order room service and watch the folio bill update in real time.

projects.name: Pulze247
projects.blurb: Real-time property dashboard for hotel owners and general managers — the vital, business-critical numbers as live graphs on their phone.

projects.name: Spizza
projects.blurb: Ordering app for a Singapore pizza chain — menu and combo ordering, payment gateway, table reservations and outlet maps.

projects.name: Personal Carpool
projects.blurb: Universal iPhone/iPad carpooling app letting drivers and riders publish, match and manage rides.
